patterns.note: A primary content structure is a full-width, multi-column table displaying project data, with clear headers and sortable columns.
The site features an extremely large, bold, uppercase sans-serif heading that initially dominates the entire viewport.
A stark monochromatic black and white color scheme is used for text and backgrounds, with a subtle green accent hinted at but not prominently displayed.
A small, subtle 'LOW IMPACT WEBSITE' text label appears and sticks to the very top of the viewport after initial scroll, providing a persistent identifier.
A large, textured background image is revealed from behind the main content area as the user scrolls down, suggesting the content has a transparent background.

technique_notes: A massive, bold, uppercase text element serves as the initial hero, filling the screen before scrolling away with the rest of the page content.
A small, secondary text label is initially hidden but becomes visible and fixed to the top of the viewport once the user scrolls past the hero section, acting as a persistent header element.
The main content sections are designed with transparent backgrounds, allowing a fixed background image to become visible as the content scrolls upwards, creating a layered depth effect.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold, uppercase headings (~8-10x body text) with a clear hierarchy to smaller, legible sans-serif for body and table content.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the initial hero section due to the massive text, transitioning to a balanced, grid-like density for the project table.

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its audacious use of an overwhelmingly large, full-width text heading that dominates the initial viewport and then scrolls away, combined with a data-heavy table layout and a background image reveal, creating a unique blend of editorial boldness and functional information display.
